## Core Services
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://www.sparktechdm.com/services/seo): Technical SEO audits, local SEO in Chennai and Choolaimedu, on-page content optimization, high-intent keyword ranking, and link building.
- [Website Development & UI/UX Design](https://www.sparktechdm.com/services/website-development): High-performance, modern, mobile-responsive custom websites built with React and modern front-end technologies for optimal lead conversion.
- [Social Media Marketing (SMM)](https://www.sparktechdm.com/services/social-media-marketing): Targeted audience engagement, Meta/Instagram paid ad campaigns, and community growth.
- [Automated Email Marketing](https://www.sparktechdm.com/services/email-marketing): Customer lifecycle nurture flows, automated sales funnels, and retention marketing.
